title: Godot Bouncy Ball 🏐🌱
controls:
- **Tap the ball** to bounce it. Every tap scores
- **Beat the clock** — you have 30 seconds
logic:
- Each tap is worth the post's **points per tap**, so a modded post can be worth more per bounce
- The ball keeps its own momentum: tap it again in mid-air to send it higher
- The run lasts **30 seconds** — score as many bounces as you can
description:
## What's This? 🏐

A ball on the grass. Tap it, it bounces, you score. You have 30 seconds.

This is the **Godot starter template** for Minit — a complete, working game kept deliberately tiny so the parts around it are easy to read: config values, the loading handshake, the result report, and audio that behaves inside the app.

## Scoring ⭐

- Every tap is worth the post's **points per tap** (10 by default)
- Catch the ball in mid-air to keep a rhythm going
- Your best score is remembered between runs 🏆

## Tips 💡

- The ball is easiest to hit at the top of its arc, where it hangs for a moment
- Let it settle if you lose it — it always comes back to the same spot 🎯
